user_story: As a user, I want the system to handle an email with special characters correctly during registration so that valid edge-case emails are accepted.

positive.title: Register with valid email containing special characters
steps: Enter a valid email address with special characters (e.g., user+name@example.com) in the email field.
Complete the rest of the registration form and submit.
positive.expected_result: The system accepts the email and successfully registers the user.

negative.title: Register with invalid email containing special characters in unsupported positions
steps: Enter an invalid email address with special characters in unsupported positions (e.g., user@example..com) in the email field.
Complete the rest of the registration form and submit.
negative.expected_result: The system rejects the email and displays an error message indicating invalid email format.

edge.title: Register with valid edge-case email containing a subdomain
steps: Enter a valid edge-case email address with a subdomain (e.g., user@mail.example.co.uk) in the email field.
Complete the rest of the registration form and submit.
edge.expected_result: The system accepts the email and registers the user, recognizing the subdomain.
